room.title: slate bridge span
room.body: A stone-paved bridge spanning the chasm between low slate parapets.

room.title: ruined bridge stairs
room.body: Broken stone steps along an elevated bridge over the ruins.

room.title: statue overlook
room.body: A slate cobblestone walkway along a stone ledge above a giant statue head, with clay pots clustered against the wall.

room.title: slate mosaic passage
room.body: A slate cobblestone passage with a circular rosette mosaic laid into the floor along ruined stone walls.

room.title: cracked mosaic landing
room.body: Cobblestone and gravel ground with a large cracked circular mosaic set between ruined slate pillars.

room.title: ruined slate walkway
room.body: A slate cobblestone walkway between broken stone walls and rubble.

room.title: pillared slate floor
room.body: Cobblestone ruin floor between tall stone pillars and a short broken flight of slate stairs.

room.title: hanging lantern walkway
room.body: Cobblestone paving beneath a hanging lantern, set between ruined stone walls.

room.title: blue rug passage
room.body: A blue patterned rug covers the slate floor between ruined stone walls, with hanging chain lamps overhead.

room.title: carpeted stone span
room.body: A stone bridge lined with a long blue carpet runner, flanked by broken slate walls, square pillars, and hanging chains.

room.title: slate catwalk
room.body: A slate cobblestone walkway flanked by low ruined walls and hanging chains.

room.title: slate ruin chamber
room.body: Slate cobblestone floor flanked by ruined stone walls, rubble, and small bone piles.

room.title: pillared stone chamber
room.body: A cobblestone floor flanked by ruined stone walls and two round pillars.
